posts.text: I quote from Chairman’s note in 2026 annual report ( Mr S C Mehta): “Our capex cycle, now nearing completion, has significantly strengthened the core of the enterprise by creating global-scale capabilities, establishing an integrated value chain, and enhancing cost competitiveness and resilience. At the same time, our ongoing journey from products to high-technology, holistic solutions for end customers marks the next phase of our transformation. Disc - invested and maybe - biased.

posts.author: Profp
posts.text: The massive capital expenditure program of roughly ₹4,650 crore, centered on two mega-projects: the Gopalpur Technical Ammonium Nitrate (TAN) project in Odisha and the Nitric Acid expansion complex in Dahej behoves well.
